title: Sign in
subtitle: Use your work account.
codeHint: Open Microsoft or Google Authenticator and enter the code shown for your account.
invalid: The email or the code is not valid.
tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
verify.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.

enroll.title: Link your authenticator app
enroll.subtitle: A one-time step. After it, you use the code every time you sign in.
enroll.step1: Install Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator on your phone.
enroll.step2: Open the app, add an account, then scan this code.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code that links the authenticator app to your account
enroll.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually
enroll.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to confirm.
enroll.invalid: The code is not valid. Check the current code and try again.
enroll.linkInvalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Ask HR for a new invitation.
enroll.failed: Could not prepare the link. Try again.
enroll.done: The app is linked to your account.
enroll.backupHint: They are shown only once. Each code works one time if you lose your phone.

microsoftFailed: Microsoft sign-in is not set up yet. Contact the system administrator.
firstTimeSent: This is your first sign-in. We e-mailed you a link with a QR code: open it, scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the code shown in the app here.
